# Whole-graph integration

All three stable-ID author lanes wrote their actual final subtrees directly in
the generated runtime graph. Root reviewed their procedures, helpers, boundaries
and citations, added provenance/license/root routing, and reconciled ownership.
No lane was silently omitted. Cases and reports stay external. Native tests were
not run during drafting; verification begins only after this integrated handoff.

Model families, shared versus private state, physical memory versus byte ledgers,
API cancellation versus native completion, simulations versus actual production
calls and source reports versus execution remain separate. Source scripts with
unsafe/resource-heavy effects are reference-only; useful bounded logic has
original standard-library bundled support. Qwen has shallow routing coverage,
not fabricated deep runtime evidence. Native/quality/service/efficacy gaps remain.
